question: Which of the following is an application of ultrasound in industry?

options.text: Increasing the speed of sound in solids

solution:
The correct answer is __**Detecting cracks in metal blocks**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ultrasound** is widely used in the industrial sector for **non-destructive testing (NDT)** of materials. It helps to detect internal flaws, such as cracks, voids, or inclusions, in metal blocks or other materials without causing any damage to the object.
 
• The principle involves sending high-frequency **ultrasound waves** through the material. These waves reflect back when they encounter a defect, and the reflected signals are analyzed to locate and measure the defect.
 
• This application is crucial in industries like **aerospace, automotive, and construction** to ensure the safety and reliability of metal components.
 
• **Ultrasound testing** is highly accurate and can detect even microscopic cracks that are invisible to the naked eye. This makes it an invaluable tool for quality control and maintenance processes.
